title: Indusara Media Network & Indusara TV
description: Built high-performance web platforms and automated streaming infrastructure powering broadcast operations with ultra-low latency.
detailHtml: Full-stack development and broadcast architecture for Indusara Media Network including Indusara TV. Designed ultra-low latency streaming pipelines with Docker containerisation and RTMP ingest servers.

title: Nysco TV & Nysco Radio
description: Custom software development and real-time streaming broadcast engine integrating simultaneous television video feeds and radio distribution.
detailHtml: Custom broadcast engine integrating simultaneous TV video and radio distribution. Built with Next.js frontend and Icecast streaming server infrastructure.

title: 24/7 YouTube Continuous Radio
description: Designed Sri Lanka's pioneer 24/7 continuous automated live audio stream on YouTube with autonomous playlist management and spectral visualizers.
detailHtml: Sri Lanka's first 24/7 continuous automated YouTube live stream with autonomous playlist management, spectral visualizers, and zero-downtime broadcasting.

title: Luminex

detailHtml: Full digital transformation project including custom web platform, motion graphics, and VFX production delivering measurable business results.
